R.definition: Delta + 48 sigma = Delta + rho (39 sigma) + displacement bound (5 sigma) + margin (4 sigma)

displacement_bound.definition: 5 sigma: family bound v_max rounded up

window: [a_k, b_k], a_k = ceil((x_k - R - z_0)/h), b_k = floor((x_k + R - z_0)/h), clipped to [0, G-1]; prefix sums and window sums on [a_k - M, b_k + M] (clipped); kernel normalisation on [a_k, b_k]

regression.positive_quantities: E[N] (P and Phat), S, log det J: |fast - ref|/|ref| <= 1e-12
regression.mass: fast version own per-step max |sum m - 1| <= 1e-10 (residual not compared between versions)

tolerances.tail_check: B, n = 12, 16 Delta vs 8 Delta, both on the fast path: the same quantities and classes with 1e-12 replaced by 1e-11
tolerances.unit_tests: (b) and (c) on the fast path: unchanged within the regression tolerances; (b) |B - 0.5| <= 1e-6, (c) mass <= 1e-10, min m >= 0
